[target] turned it around and herself proposed, developed and now runs a giant mine in the mining region, as well as extensive agricultural businesses. The company is now so important to this country that last year alone it paid $2.7 billion in taxes for schools and hospitals and so on. Normally, [target] doesn't give interviews. She doesn't trust journalists. She's right. But we've been friends for years and she wouldn't even come on my show. But today she will. Because the pandemic and the conflict in Eastern Europe, the rise of a major Asian power, all of these make her think, as I do, that our country really must wake up.
